mapper.select: /* TITLENAME:标题名(普通产品取产品名称 ,分级产品取 母产品名称+（子产品代码）) PRODNAME：产品名称（普通产品取产品名称 ,分级产品取母产品名称） PRODID：产品代码（普通产品取产品代码 ,分级产品取子产品代码） REGCODE：产品登记编码（普通产品取产品登记编码 ,分级产品取母产品登记编码） */ select rpi.prod_id PRODID, case when rpi.IS_GRADE = '01' then rpi2.prod_name ||'（'||rpi.prod_id||'）' else rpi.prod_name end TITLENAME, rpi2.prod_name PRODNAME, rpi2.prod_re REGCODE from rep_prod_info rpi /*查询普通产品或者母产品数据 p_prod_id:母产品代码：当为子产品时填写母产品代码。普通产品为自己的产品代码。母产品为空*/ left join rep_prod_info rpi2 on rpi.p_prod_id = rpi2.prod_id and rpi2.status = 'E' where rpi.prod_id = #{prodId} and rpi.status = 'E'

select to_char(t.value_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') VALUEDATE, to_char(nvl(t.UNIT_VALUE,0),'FM9999999999999999.0000') PRDVALUE, to_char(nvl(t.UNIT_VALUE_T,0),'FM9999999999999999.0000') TOTALVALUE, to_char(nvl(t.UNIT_VALUE,0),'FM9999999999999999.0000') SGAMT, to_char(nvl(t.UNIT_VALUE,0),'FM9999999999999999.0000') SHAMT from REP_PROD_INDEX t where t.prod_id = #{prodId} and t.value_date = #{valueDate} and t.status = 'E'

select * from ( select to_char(t.value_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') cDate, to_char(nvl(t.UNIT_VALUE,0),'FM9999999999999999.0000') value, to_char(nvl(t.UNIT_VALUE_T,0),'FM9999999999999999.0000') totalValue from REP_PROD_INDEX t where t.prod_id = #{prodId} and t.value_date <= #{valueDate} and t.status = 'E' and exists ( select 1 from CHB_MKT_HOLIDAY h where h.market_code = '04' and h.is_holiday = '0' and t.value_date = h.busi_date ) order by t.value_date desc ) where rownum <= 30
